card.name: Digits and spaces before numbers in oncology text
card.fires_on: Responds to a space or single digit just before a number, such as the 2 in 24 weeks or 4 cycles, or the 1 in 2010. Seen mainly in cancer treatment and breast cancer trial text.

modes.description: A bare space right before a number of weeks or cycles in chemotherapy dosing.
